title: Data of coefficient-linear normalized scalar level comparisons
statement: With the sites, coefficient tower, algebra maps and presentations of [def-sf-semilinear-slice-scalar-data], define sliceScalarComponentHom by transporting an actual level comparison along AX.obj_eq, AV.obj_eq and extension.obj_eq. Define SliceScalarLevelComparison to record coefficient-linear level isomorphisms, their formula on all original pure generators and uniqueness, the scalar-restriction identification preserving original summands and its uniqueness, and compatibility with all coefficient transitions and module morphisms. These are exactly the existing data declarations formerly in SliceScalarLevelComparison, with no change in their types or bodies. No existence assertion is made.
